# Anchor

## Inputs

Approved copy, client brand files, two to four assigned references, and cover prompt records.

## Process

Generate exactly three distinct cover compositions before any remaining slide. Color swaps do not count as distinct compositions. Inspect exact text and hierarchy at full size and 320 pixels wide. Lock no more than two font families, no more than three primary colors, one visual thread, and the required safe zones. Check minimum sizes, stable contrast, safe zones, and brand fit. Confirm rights. Then test curiosity. Select and refine one visual anchor.

## Outputs

Three candidate files plus their hashes, comparison notes, the selected candidate, and frozen anchor rules in `visual-brief.md`. Save the prompt records too.

## Human check

Approve one cover and its anchor rules before the remaining slides are generated.
